question: A solid cylinder has a radius of 5 cm and a height of 10 cm. A smaller cylindrical hole of radius 3 cm is drilled coaxially through its entire length. What is the approximate volume of the remaining solid?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of a hollow cylinder = Base Area × Height

Volume = π × (R² − r²) × H

Volume = 3.14 × (5² − 3²) × 10

Volume = 3.14 × 16 × 10 = 502.4 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 502 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Outer radius (R) = 5 cm

Inner radius (r) = 3 cm

Height (H) = 10 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a hollow cylinder = πH(R² − r²)

 
 

 

 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• 
 
• 
 
 
 r=3
 R=5
 
 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 H = 10 cm
 
 
 Remaining Volume = πH(R² − r²)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume of the original solid cylinder = πR²H = π × 5² × 10 = 250π

⇒ Volume of the cylindrical hole = πr²H = π × 3² × 10 = 90π

⇒ Remaining Volume = 250π − 90π

⇒ Remaining Volume = 160π

⇒ Using π ≈ 3.14

⇒ Remaining Volume = 160 × 3.14 = 502.4 cm³

⇒ Approximating to the nearest integer, we get 502 cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 502 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Hollow Cylinder

The TSA includes the outer curved surface, inner curved surface, and the two circular rings at the top and bottom. Formula: 2πR H + 2πr H + 2π(R² − r²).

Curved Surface Area of Hollow Cylinder

The CSA only considers the lateral vertical surfaces (both inside and outside). Formula: CSA = 2πH(R + r).

Solid Cylinder Formulas

For a completely solid right circular cylinder with radius R and height H, Volume = πR²H and Total Surface Area = 2πR(R + H).
